3258-a-laodicean-a-story-of-to-day.title: A Laodicean A Story Of To Day
3258-a-laodicean-a-story-of-to-day.creator: Thomas Hardy
3258-a-laodicean-a-story-of-to-day.description: A book by Thomas Hardy. The sun blazed down and down, till it was within half-an-hour of its setting; but the sketcher still lingered at his occupation of measuring and copying the chevroned doorway--a bold and quaint example of a transitional style of architecture, which formed the tower entrance to an English village church.

37372-in-the-russian-ranks-a-soldier-s-a.title: A Soldier's Account of the Fighting in Poland
37372-in-the-russian-ranks-a-soldier-s-a.creator: Unknown
37372-in-the-russian-ranks-a-soldier-s-a.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Always a student of military matters, at this hour I loved war, and all that pertained to war; now I loathe it with an ineradicable hate and disgust, and hope never again to see ground crimsoned with blood.

8955-far-above-rubies.title: Far Above Rubies
8955-far-above-rubies.creator: Unknown
8955-far-above-rubies.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. That he had leisure for the indulgence of his bent was the result of his peculiar position. He lived in the house of his father, and was in his father’s employment, so that he was able both to accommodate himself to his father’s requirements and at the same time fully indulge his own especial taste.

arxiv-1804-06836.title: Delayed Blockchain Protocols
arxiv-1804-06836.creator: Drew Stone
arxiv-1804-06836.description: Abstract . Given the parallels between game theory and consensus, it makes sense to intelligently design blockchain or DAG protocols with an incentive-compatible-first mentality. To that end, we propose a new blockchain or DAG protocol enhancement based on delayed rewards.

arxiv-2103-04411.title: Instanton bundles on ℙ 1 × 𝔽 1 {\mathbb{P}^{1}}\times\mathbb{F}_{1} Thanks: The first and second authors are a member of GNSAGA group of INdAM and are supported by the framework of the MIUR grant Dipartimenti di Eccellenza 2018-2022 (E11G18000350001). The third author is supported by the grant MAEST
arxiv-2103-04411.creator: V. Antonelli, G. Casnati, O. Genc
arxiv-2103-04411.description: Abstract . In this paper we deal with a particular class of rank two vector bundles ( instanton bundles) on the Fano threefold of index one F := 𝔽 1 × ℙ 1 F:=\mathbb{F}_{1}\times\mathbb{P}^{1} . We show that every instanton bundle on F F can be described as the cohomology of a monad whose terms are free sheaves.

arxiv-2110-08200.title: Lognormals, Power Laws and Double Power Laws in the Distribution of Frequencies of Harmonic Codewords from Classical Music
arxiv-2110-08200.creator: Marc Serra-Peralta, Joan Serrà, Álvaro Corral
arxiv-2110-08200.description: Abstract Zipf’s law is a paradigm describing the importance of different elements in communication systems, especially in linguistics. Despite the complexity of the hierarchical structure of language, music has in some sense an even more complex structure, due to its multidimensional character (melody, harmony, rhythm, timbre, etc.). Thus, the relevance of Zipf’s law in music is still an open question.

arxiv-2211-02051.title: Fearless Steps Challenge (FS-I) 2019 Evaluation Plan
arxiv-2211-02051.creator: Aditya Joglekar, John H.L. Hansen
arxiv-2211-02051.description: Abstract Last Edited: May 20, 2019 Disclaimer: The Fearless Steps corpus is derived from a five-year NSF CISE funded project awarded to CRSS at the University of Texas at Dallas. UTDallas-CRSS established the hardware/software solutions to digitize and diarize 19,000 hrs of NASA Apollo data.

arxiv-2312-11651.title: Bridging Logic and Learning: A Neural-Symbolic Approach for Enhanced Reasoning in Neural Models (ASPER)
arxiv-2312-11651.creator: Fadi Al Machot
arxiv-2312-11651.description: Abstract Neural-symbolic learning, an intersection of neural networks and symbolic reasoning, aims to blend neural networks’ learning capabilities with symbolic AI’s interpretability and reasoning. This paper introduces an approach designed to improve the performance of neural models in learning reasoning tasks.

arxiv-2406-09038.title: CGP++ : A Modern C++ Implementation of Cartesian Genetic Programming
arxiv-2406-09038.creator: Roman Kalkreuth, Thomas Bäck
arxiv-2406-09038.description: Abstract . The reference implementation of Cartesian Genetic Programming (CGP) was written in the C programming language. C inherently follows a procedural programming paradigm, which entails challenges in providing a reusable and scalable implementation model for complex structures and methods.

arxiv-2411-00150.title: Schema Augmentation for Zero-Shot Domain Adaptation in Dialogue State Tracking
arxiv-2411-00150.creator: Christopher Richardson, Roshan Sharma, Anirudh Sundar, Neeraj Gaur, Parisa Haghani, Bhuvana Ramabhadran
arxiv-2411-00150.description: Abstract Zero-shot domain adaptation for dialogue state tracking (DST) remains a challenging problem in task-oriented dialogue (TOD) systems, where models must generalize to target domains unseen at training time. Current large language model approaches for zero-shot domain adaptation rely on prompting to introduce knowledge pertaining to the target domains.

arxiv-2501-15688.title: Transformer-Based Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion with Link-Aware Contexts
arxiv-2501-15688.creator: Haodi Ma, Dzmitry Kasinets, Daisy Zhe Wang
arxiv-2501-15688.description: Abstract Multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC) aims to predict missing links in multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) by leveraging information from various modalities alongside structural data. Existing MMKGC approaches primarily extend traditional knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models, which often require creating an embedding for every entity.

arxiv-2502-01251.title: On field line slippage rates in the solar corona
arxiv-2502-01251.creator: D.David MacTaggart
arxiv-2502-01251.description: Abstract Magnetic reconnection is one of the fundamental dynamical processes in the solar corona. The method of studying reconnection in active region-scale magnetic fields generally depends on non-local methods (i.e. requiring information across the magnetic field under study) of magnetic topology, such as separatrix skeletons and quasi-separatrix layers.

arxiv-2508-06393.title: Robust Target Speaker Diarization and Separation via Augmented Speaker Embedding Sampling
arxiv-2508-06393.creator: Md Asif, Luca, Vasileios, Thanasis, Vandana, Karthikeyan, Anastasis, Junho, Hyuk, Seokyeong
arxiv-2508-06393.description: Abstract Traditional speech separation and speaker diarization approaches rely on prior knowledge of target speakers or a predetermined number of participants in audio signals. To address these limitations, recent advances focus on developing enrollment-free methods capable of identifying targets without explicit speaker labeling.

arxiv-2512-11626.title: The cosmological volume function Thanks: I thank Miguel Sánchez for conversations at early stages of this work, and Greg Galloway for detailed feedback on the first draft of this paper. This research was funded by the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) [Grant DOI 10.55776/EFP6]. For open access purposes, t
arxiv-2512-11626.creator: Leonardo García-Heveling
arxiv-2512-11626.description: Abstract . In a previous work, the regular cosmological volume function τ V \tau_{V} was introduced as an alternative to the regular cosmological time function of Andersson, Galloway, and Howard. In this paper, we show that in many cases of interest, τ V \tau_{V} is a continuously differentiable temporal function.

arxiv-2601-06311.title: C-EQ-ALINEA – Distributed, Coordinated, and Equitable Ramp Metering Strategy for Sustainable Freeway Operations
arxiv-2601-06311.creator: Kevin Riehl, Omar Alami Badissi, Anastasios Kouvelas, Michail A. Makridis
arxiv-2601-06311.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Kevin Riehl, Omar Alami Badissi, Anastasios Kouvelas, Michail A. Makridis. Ramp metering is a widely deployed traffic management strategy for improving freeway efficiency, yet conventional approaches often lead to highly uneven delay distributions across on-ramps, undermining user acceptance and long-term sustainability. While existing fairness-aware ramp metering methods can mitigate such disparities, they typically rely on centralized optimization, detailed traffic models, or data-intensive learning frameworks, limiting their real-world applicability, particularly in networks operating legacy ALINEA-based systems.

pmc-10480422.title: Transformation and regeneration of DNA polymerase Θ mutant rice plants
pmc-10480422.creator: Ayako Nishizawa‐Yokoi, Stanton B. Gelvin
pmc-10480422.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Agrobacterium T‐DNA integration into the plant genome is essential for the process of transgenesis and is widely used for genome engineering. The importance of the non‐homologous end‐joining (NHEJ) protein DNA polymerase Θ, encoded by the PolQ gene, for T‐DNA integration is controversial, with some groups claiming it is essential whereas others claim T‐DNA integration in Arabidopsis and rice polQ mutant plant tissue. Because of pleiotropic effects of PolQ loss on plant development, scientists have previously had difficulty regenerating transgenic polQ mutant plants.

pmc-10743516.title: Targeting Fatty Acid Amide Hydrolase Counteracts the Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition in Keratinocyte-Derived Tumors
pmc-10743516.creator: Daniela Kovacs, Enrica Flori, Emanuela Bastonini, Sarah Mosca, Emilia Migliano, Carlo Cota, Marco Zaccarini, Stefania Briganti, Giorgia Cardinali, Rosaria Meccariello
pmc-10743516.description: The endocannabinoid system regulates physiological processes, and the modulation of endogenous endocannabinoid (eCB) levels is an attractive tool to contrast the development of pathological skin conditions including cancers. Inhibiting FAAH (fatty acid amide hydrolase), the degradation enzyme of the endocannabinoid anandamide (AEA) leads to the increase in AEA levels, thus enhancing its biological effects.

pmc-11371552.title: Posterior Component Separation Technique—Original Transversus Abdominis Release (TAR) Technique
pmc-11371552.creator: Jignesh A. Gandhi, Aarsh P. Gajjar, Pravin H. Shinde, Sadashiv Chaudhari
pmc-11371552.description: The history of ventral hernia repair techniques has seen substantial evolution, from primary suture repair to the introduction of mesh-based procedures, aiming to reduce recurrence rates. Notable advancements include the anterior and posterior component separation techniques. The Transversus Abdominis Release (TAR) technique, a refinement of the posterior approach, emerged to address challenges associated with complex ventral hernias.

pmc-12473372.title: A Radar Waveform Design Method Based on Multicarrier Phase Coding for Suppressing Autocorrelation Sidelobes
pmc-12473372.creator: Ji Li, Liu Ye, Wei Wang
pmc-12473372.description: Multicarrier phase-coded radar waveforms show significant potential in broadband radar applications by integrating phase coding with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technology. However, their inherent high autocorrelation sidelobe levels limit system performance. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a two-stage joint optimization waveform design method.

pmc-12595739.title: Long-term outcomes of phacoemulsification and intraocular lens implantation combined with goniosynechialysis for primary angle-closure glaucoma with 360° peripheral anterior synechiae
pmc-12595739.creator: Junhua Li, Yuchen Gu, Hengli Lian, Na Li, Liqing Wei, Wanting Wu, Tingting Li, Weihua Pan
pmc-12595739.description: BackgroundPhacoemulsification combined with intraocular lens implantation and goniosynechialysis (PEI + GSL) represents a mainstream ​surgical technique​for the treatment of primary angle-closure glaucoma (PACG). As the disease progresses, when the extent of peripheral anterior synechiae (PAS) gradually expands to 360°, whether PEI + GSL remains effective remains uncertain.

pmc-13128154.title: U.S. English‐Speaking Children and Adults Exhibit a “Gleam‐Glum” Sound Symbolic Effect Linking Phonemic Vowel Sounds With Emotional Valence
pmc-13128154.creator: Ye Li, Christine S‐P Yu, Michael K McBeath, Viridiana L Benitez
pmc-13128154.description: We tested a recently‐found sound symbolic effect, the gleam‐glum effect, in which words with the [i]‐phoneme (like “gleam”) are perceived as emotionally more positive than matched words with the [Ʌ]‐phoneme (like “glum”). We extend prior work and verify this effect using a novel online pseudoword‐to‐scene matching task, testing U.S.

pmc-13222618.title: Optimizing Early Recovery Quality in Same-Day Discharge Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Narrative Review
pmc-13222618.creator: Junfei Guo, Erliang Li, Chengcheng Zhao, Lin Xiao, Peng Xu, Xin Xu
pmc-13222618.description: The paradigm of total hip arthroplasty (THA) is undergoing a transformative shift from prolonged inpatient care toward same-day discharge (SDD), driven by the convergence of enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols, advances in anesthesia and analgesia, and evolving reimbursement policies.

pmc-13262650.title: Climate Change Adaptation to Smoke Haze for Improved Child Health in Southeast Asia: Analysis Situation in Palembang, Indonesia
pmc-13262650.creator: Budi Haryanto, Fitri Kurniasari, Indang Trihandini, Fajar Nugraha, Nabila Gayatri Widayana, Nurul Laksmi Winarni
pmc-13262650.description: Background: Haze from forest and peatland fires is a major recurring hazard in Indonesia. During the 2015 fire crisis, more than 43 million people were affected, with PM10 concentrations reaching 2,108.5 μg/m³ in Palangkaraya, while children were among the most vulnerable populations due to their increased susceptibility to air pollution.

pmc-13396799.title: Assessment of Rhodococcus sp. (MG1) induced biochemical alterations and genotoxicity in Spodoptera litura
pmc-13396799.creator: Pallvi Mehra, Arushi Mahajan, Jaswinder Kaur, Satish Koundal, Shiv Kumar, Pooja Chadha, Harvinder Singh Saini, Sanehdeep Kaur
pmc-13396799.description: Spodoptera litura (Lepidoptera: Noctuidae) is recognised as a major agricultural pest causing economic losses to a number of agricultural and vegetable crops. Chemical insecticides remain the primary control method. However, excessive and repeated applications have led to the evolution of resistance, environmental contamination and risk to nontarget organisms.

pmc-13520460.title: Perioperative biomarkers and graft function in living donor kidney transplantation: focus on postoperative prognostic nutritional index
pmc-13520460.creator: Mustafa Anıl Turhan, Javid Ahmadov, Burak Kutlu, Furkan Atakan Akın, Seda Akyol, İhsan Ergün, Acar Tüzüner
pmc-13520460.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEarly identification of factors associated with renal allograft function remains important in kidney transplantation. Nutritional, inflammatory, and hemodynamic markers may provide complementary information on post-transplant recovery, but their prognostic value in living donor kidney transplantation remains unclear.
